items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: And he was saying, Blue, he's calling me the devil... And he's calling me Blue, Blue, catch that devil man.

ctx.x: Well he used to, my daddy was, he used to come to be in what they call a wine head. And he used to bum on Espe, on the domain in Viro, and he used to call it Boss. But I mean a lot of them old heads, they're gone. But Slowdrag knows something about my daddy, by the name of Boss. Well that's the place he used to hang out every day. A better fella fell right in his footsteps. Samway hanging in the bottom, just like that. And he took the harvest, you know, and he died. Another foe, another word, he died from an…
What kind of a drum set did you have? How big was your band?
